text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Results of university entrance baccalaureate exams released; average success rate is 35.8 percent; 58.01 percent in mathematics.
- Exports rose 14.6 percent during first five months of 1997 compared with same period of 1996.
- Conferences being set up by government agencies and ruling party for next few weeks to encourage Tunisians working abroad who return home for summer holidays to invest in mother country.
- In southern city of Tataouine on fringes of desert, 82 percent of rural population now has access to drinking water.
- Cabinet ministers touring countryside to explain draft to amend constitution.
- Libya might recruit hundreds of Tunisian workers for project to build 60,000 houses.
